scope: Distillation SQLite queue database-family corruption recovery

acceptance.family_identity: The main database and every discovered -wal/-shm sidecar move under one collision-resistant recovery identifier.
acceptance.failure_fence: A family-member rename failure propagates before bootstrap, probe, receipt, or resumed queue use.
acceptance.fresh_queue: Recovery bootstraps a new WAL queue at the original path and requires a transactional write/read probe before recording success.
acceptance.auditability: A sanitized, fsynced JSON receipt records the recovery identifier, moved member names, and successful probe without exception text or file content.
acceptance.repetition: Every recovery uses a UUID-qualified identifier, so equal timestamps cannot overwrite earlier quarantine evidence.

verification.command: uv run --with pytest pytest -q services/source_ingestion/tests/test_distillation_worker.py -k 'corrupt_queue or family_rename or repeated_recovery or non_corruption'
